evals.name: adapt-wireframe-light-screen
evals.prompt: I wireframed a savings goal tracker in Figma yesterday. It's a simple white screen with a progress ring, some text, and a green button at the bottom. The Figma file is aIPVqxi0yYCQL5Er7aQt92 node 2349:1407. Adapt it for Flash prototypes so it looks like it belongs in the app.
evals.expected_output: A design_spec.md with light palette, Flash token mappings, no contrast violations

assertions.text: Spec classifies screen as light/white palette (not dark)
dayBreak is NOT used for text on the white background (contrast violation)
Green wireframe button maps to PrimaryButton or ElevatedButton using theme defaults
All colors reference Flash color.dart tokens -- no raw hex values in the mapping
Typography mapped to textTheme style names (displayLarge, titleLarge, etc.)
Output follows the design_spec.md template structure with sections for colors, typography, components

evals.name: adapt-wireframe-dark-header
evals.prompt: Here's my wireframe for a daily market snapshot. It has a dark header area at the top with a date and summary cards, then white content below with a list of market movers. Figma file Cmr9tEIbWHCOXiXuhoaIX5 node 4642:1940. Adapt this for Flash.
evals.expected_output: A design_spec.md with mixed palette classification, correct dark/light section tokens, no contrast violations

assertions.text: Spec identifies mixed screen (dark header + light content)
Dark header section uses darkNight or primary for background, white or dayBreak for text
Light content section uses white background with primary for text (not dayBreak)
Contrast rules respected at the dark/light boundary -- no dayBreak on white bg
Component mapping present -- wireframe elements mapped to Flash components where applicable

evals.name: extract-production-design
evals.prompt: Extract the Buy Gold education sheet design from Figma. File aIPVqxi0yYCQL5Er7aQt92 node 10160:106. This is a polished production design -- match tokens precisely.
evals.expected_output: A design_spec.md with precise hex-to-token matching, flagged unknowns, subagent extraction

assertions.text: Colors matched to nearest Flash token by hex proximity (precise matching, not creative adaptation)
Non-matching colors flagged with FLAGGED comment rather than silently assigned
Extraction dispatched to subagent (not done inline in main conversation)
Figma node IDs preserved in spec for fix cycles
Spacing values extracted from Figma (exact px, not invented)

evals.name: build-from-spec
evals.prompt: Build the savings goal tracker prototype. It should show a progress ring toward a savings target of 85,000 EGP (currently at 42,500 EGP), a 'New MacBook Pro' goal name, recent contributions list, and an 'Add Money' button at the bottom.
evals.expected_output: Flutter prototype with correct structure, dumb widgets, Flash tokens, launcher registration

assertions.text: Correct directory structure: lib/prototypes/savings_goal/ with models/, providers/, widgets/ subdirectories
Widget files contain NO Riverpod imports (no ref, no Provider, no ConsumerWidget)
Code imports flash/theme/color.dart -- no hardcoded hex color values like Color(0xFF...)
Text styles use Theme.of(context).textTheme.* -- no raw TextStyle() constructors with fontSize
main.dart updated with a FeatureGroup/PrototypeEntry for the savings goal tracker
Mock data uses EGP amounts (85000, 42500 or similar Egyptian currency values)
